works.title: Invective Arsenal for Satirical Political Commentary
works.description: A categorized, recombinable repertoire of contemptuous epithets, diminutives, and invective patterns designed for satirical voices targeting powerful figures. Includes 200+ archetypally-grounded historical and literary deep cuts formatted as an AI-readable markdown cheat sheet with generative grammar principles.
works.quote: Build an extensive, recombinable arsenal of contemptuous diminutives and epithets that a satirical voice can deploy against the powerful — modeled on the stickiness of coinages like 'Little Marco,' 'Rocket Man,' 'Shrub,' 'vampire squid.' The point is not a static list but a generative grammar the voice can riff from indefinitely.

works.title: Ideation Framework
works.description: A methodology for transforming raw creative material into organized, implementable narrative elements using character choice architecture and universal human pattern recognition. Targets ~9 concise, formatted story beats where each beat represents a single character action or choice.
works.quote: This framework transforms raw creative material into organized, implementable narrative elements. It uses character choice architecture and universal human pattern recognition to distill broad concepts into a target of ~9 concise, formatted story beats, ensuring each beat represents a single, clear action or choice.
